_comment: All numbers are illustrative and invented. Change seed or any value, then re-run generate_data.py.

onboarding_time._comment: Two-part distribution calibrated to the PRD: median 60h, p90 450h, mean 118h. Body = lognormal truncated at p90_hours; tail = p90_hours + Exponential(tail_theta), capped.

churn._comment: Probability the earner never completes onboarding (gives up), by onboarding-time group. 0.10 vs 0.99 gives a ~10x ratio and an eventual pass rate of ~81%.

agent_queue_share._comment: Share of an earner's onboarding time spent in agent handling + queue. PRD: 40% for the p90+ tail; body mean tuned so the overall mean is ~31h.

rejections_by_onboarding_time._comment: Probability of 0, 1, 2 rejection cycles on a check, by upper bound (hours) of the earner's total onboarding time.

pending_reasons._comment: awaiting_agent_review is the only platform-side reason; the other two are earner-side.
